items.statement: Stationary-point assignment requires frequency validation of minima and transition states.
items.expected: Submission reports all-positive frequencies for minima and one negative frequency for each claimed TS, or honestly records failure.

items.statement: A meaningful independent investigation distinguishes alternative direct and stepwise reaction hypotheses with explicit candidate/path tests.
items.expected: Submission names multiple hypotheses and gives candidate-specific discrimination evidence.

items.statement: The paper provides a concrete hydride-transfer barrier for the defined 2a system.
items.expected: Submission reports a barrier in kcal/mol with its energy definition.
